How Apple Cash Family works — and why listing copy is a separate job

Teams assume Family Sharing and Apple Cash capability cover storefront language. Apple Cash Family behavior, Family Setup, and App Store Connect actually separate family cash controls from product-page copy:

  • Settings → Family → Apple Cash (Family Setup) — family organizer configures Apple Cash for child or teen accounts in the Family Sharing group. Sets spending limits, enables parent approval for transactions, and can send allowance. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Spending limits (Apple Cash 限额) — caps how much a child or teen can spend from Apple Cash before parent approval is required. Gallery frames may show limit sliders or cap badges — listing copy should name 限额 or 消费限额 when that is what the screenshot depicts.
  • Parent approval for Apple Cash transactions (家长审批) — organizer approves or declines child or teen Apple Cash sends and spends before they complete. Distinct from Ask to Buy App Store purchase gates — this page covers Apple Cash transaction approval under Family Setup.
  • Send allowance (向家人发零花钱) — organizer sends recurring or one-time allowance to a family member's Apple Cash balance. Marketing frames may show allowance schedule UI or "Send allowance" walkthroughs — caption lines should name 零花钱 or 发零花钱 when art shows that path.
  • Child and teen Apple Cash (儿童 Apple Cash / 青少年 Apple Cash) — Apple Cash balances managed under Family Setup for minors in the family group. Listing copy uses 儿童 Apple Cash or 青少年 Apple Cash alongside 家庭 Apple Cash when gallery frames show minor-account balance screens.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Apple Cash Family marketing in your app.

Working Apple Cash Family on device and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.
